snippet.title: MICRO BATTLES 2 - iOS Android [Donut Games]
snippet.description:
Gather your friends for another series of HEAD TO HEAD mini-games, inspired by the fun simplicity of classic 8-BIT VIDEO GAMES.

Free for iOS - http://bit.ly/1qRYYGN
Free for Android - http://bit.ly/1zofwXE

Donut Games website:
http://www.donutgames.com

Credit goes to Goto80 for the chiptune Bullcactus used in this video.
